threads.body: [Config] The new exact selector omits Protostellar’s component baseline. This module starts at Couchbase 3.4.3 (the matcher and Muzzle range both establish that), so the convention’s component-version ordering calls for `couchbase-3.2-protostellar-3.4.3`, not the unversioned component selector.

[Config] This exact selector drops the component’s 2.3 baseline. The cluster module only applies from Jedis 2.3 (as documented by the class-loader matcher and Muzzle range), and the convention requires a component-specific version after the component. Without it, `jedis-2.0-cluster` does not fully identify the selected component baseline; use `jedis-2.0-cluster-2.3`.

There are 2 instrumentations only because the code lives in separate jars. If I remember correctly play tests had only 1 of these jars.
adding `"akka-http-10.0-server"` would ensure that this instrumentation is disabled along with the server instrumentation

[Config] The non-preview branch drops the existing `kotlinx-coroutines-1.0-core` selector. As a result, `otel.instrumentation.kotlinx-coroutines-1.0-core.enabled` no longer controls this module even when v3 preview is disabled. Preserve this legacy alias after `kotlinx-coroutines-1.0`; only the preview branch should use the consolidated selectors.
